nodes.summary: For `0 < p ≤ x ≤ z < 1` the conditional sojourn density is the paper's `Ψ₂(z)`; it does not depend on `p`.
nodes.title: Closed form above the current frequency

nodes.summary: For `0 < p ≤ z ≤ x < 1` the conditional sojourn density is the paper's `Ψ₁(z)`; it depends neither on `p` nor on `x`.
nodes.title: Closed form below the current frequency

nodes.summary: The Maruyama–Kimura conditional sojourn density (the paper's `Ψ_z(p, z)`): given the initial frequency `p` and the current frequency `x`, the density of mean time spent at frequency `z` along the path, `Ψ(p, z) Ψ(z, x) / Ψ(p, x)` (Maruyama and Kimura 1975; Kiezun et al. 2013, Methods). Time in units of `2N` generations.
nodes.title: Maruyama–Kimura conditional sojourn density

nodes.summary: The sojourn density is continuous in the starting frequency (in particular at `p = x`).
nodes.title: Continuity of the sojourn density in the starting frequency

nodes.summary: Green's representation with selection (Ewens 2004, Chapter 4; the integrated form of the paper's `-δ(x - p) = s p (1 - p) ∂Ψ/∂p + p (1 - p) / (4N) ∂²Ψ/∂p²`). For continuous `g` and `p ∈ (0, 1)`, `v(q) = ∫₀¹ Ψ(q, x) g(x) dx` solves `L_σ v = -g` at `p`; with `integral_selectionGreen_left` and `integral_selectionGreen_right` (`v(0) = v(1) = 0`) this generalizes `generator_integral_neutralGreen` to `σ ≠ 0`. In the…
nodes.title: Green's representation with selection

nodes.summary: Above the target frequency: `L_σ Ψ(·, x) = 0` at every `p > x`.
nodes.title: Sojourn density solves the backward equation above the target

nodes.summary: Below the target frequency the sojourn density solves the homogeneous backward equation in its first argument: `L_σ Ψ(·, x) = 0` at every `p < x` (pointwise form of the paper's `-δ(x - p) = L_σ Ψ(·, x)`).
nodes.title: Sojourn density solves the backward equation below the target

nodes.summary: For genic selection `b x = σ x (1 - x)`, `a x = x (1 - x)`, the general Green's function `greenFunction` is `selectionGreen σ` on `[0, 1] × (0, 1)`. The scale function is `S(y) = u(y) / u'(0)` with `u = kimuraFixation σ` and `u'(0) = kimuraSlope σ`, since both have derivative `ψ(y) = e^{-2σy}` and vanish at `0`; substituting that and `S(1) = 1 / u'(0)` into `greenFunction` gives `selectionGreen`.
nodes.title: The general Green kernel specializes to Kimura's sojourn density

nodes.summary: Right derivative at the diagonal: `∂_p Ψ(x⁺, x) = -2 u(x) / (x (1 - x))`.
nodes.title: Right derivative of the sojourn density at the diagonal

nodes.summary: Left derivative at the diagonal: `∂_p Ψ(x⁻, x) = 2 (1 - u(x)) / (x (1 - x))`. Together with `hasDerivWithinAt_selectionGreen_Ici` this gives the jump `-2 / (x (1 - x))` of `∂_p Ψ` at `p = x`, i.e. `L_σ Ψ(·, x) = -δ_x` in the distributional sense.
nodes.title: Left derivative of the sojourn density at the diagonal

nodes.summary: Boundary value at `0`: an absent allele spends no time in `(0, 1)`, so `∫₀¹ Ψ(0, x) g(x) dx = 0` for every `g`.
nodes.title: Sojourn density from frequency zero vanishes

nodes.summary: Boundary value at `1`: a fixed allele spends no time in `(0, 1)`, so `∫₀¹ Ψ(1, x) g(x) dx = 0` for every `g`.
nodes.title: Sojourn density from frequency one vanishes

nodes.summary: `Ψ₂` is integrable on `[x, 1]` for `x ∈ (0, 1)` (it is bounded by `2 / (1 - x)`).
nodes.title: Integrability of the sojourn density above the current frequency

nodes.summary: `Ψ₁` is integrable on `[0, x]` (it is bounded by `2`).
nodes.title: Integrability of the sojourn density below the current frequency

nodes.summary: An allele at frequency below `1` is lost with positive probability.
nodes.title: Kimura's fixation probability is less than one

nodes.summary: An allele present at positive frequency has positive fixation probability.
nodes.title: Positivity of Kimura's fixation probability

nodes.summary: The slope constant of Kimura's formula is positive.
nodes.title: Positivity of the slope constant in Kimura's formula

nodes.summary: Mean time as a sum of sojourn times (the identity behind Maruyama and Kimura 1975). For a jointly measurable family of transition densities `w p x t ≥ 0` on `(0, 1)` satisfying the Chapman–Kolmogorov equation for positive times, `∫₀^∞ t w(p, x, t) dt = ∫₀¹ Ψ(p, y) Ψ(y, x) dy` with `Ψ(p, x) = ∫₀^∞ w(p, x, t) dt`, in `ℝ≥0∞`. Dividing by `Ψ(p, x)` reads `∫₀¹ Ψ(p, y) Ψ(y, x) / Ψ(p, x) dy` (the integral of `ageDensity`…
nodes.title: Mean time as a sum of sojourn times

nodes.summary: `Ψ₂` in hyperbolic form: `2 sinh(σ(1 - z))² sinh(σx) / (σ sinh σ sinh(σ(1 - x)) z (1 - z))` for `σ ≠ 0`.
nodes.title: Hyperbolic form of the sojourn density above the current frequency

nodes.summary: `Ψ₂` through Kimura's fixation probability: `Ψ₂(z) = 2 u(x)(1 - u(z))² / ((1 - u(x)) z (1 - z) u'(z))` on `(0, 1)`.
nodes.title: Sojourn density above the current frequency via fixation probability

nodes.summary: The paper's `Ψ₂(z) = (e^{-γ(1-z)} - 1)(e^{γ(1-z)} - 1)(1 - e^{γx}) / (s z (1 - z)(e^{-γ(1-x)} - 1)(1 - e^{γ}))`, `γ = 4Ns`, equals `2N · maruyamaAbove (2Ns) x z`.
nodes.title: Paper units

nodes.summary: For `0 ≤ σ < τ` and `0 < x < z < 1`, `Ψ₂` at `τ` is strictly below `Ψ₂` at `σ`.
nodes.title: Stronger selection, smaller `Ψ₂`

nodes.summary: For `σ ≠ 0` and `0 < x < z < 1`, `Ψ₂(z)` is strictly below its neutral value `2 x (1 - z) / ((1 - x) z)`.
nodes.title: Maruyama effect, above the current frequency

nodes.summary: `Ψ₂` is the same for `σ` and `-σ`.
nodes.title: Symmetry

nodes.summary: At `z = 1` the closed form `Ψ₂` vanishes (a null set for the integral).
nodes.title: Sojourn density above the current frequency vanishes at one

nodes.summary: `Ψ₂` is positive for `0 < x < z < 1`.
nodes.title: Positivity of the sojourn density above the current frequency

nodes.summary: The paper's closed form `Ψ₂(z)` for `x < z < 1` (Kiezun et al. 2013, Methods), in units of `2N` generations with `σ = 2Ns`: `(e^{-2σ(1-z)} - 1)(e^{2σ(1-z)} - 1)(1 - e^{2σx}) / (σ z (1 - z)(e^{-2σ(1-x)} - 1)(1 - e^{2σ}))`, and its continuous extension `2 x (1 - z) / ((1 - x) z)` for `σ = 0`.
nodes.title: Closed-form sojourn density above the current frequency

nodes.summary: `Ψ₁` in hyperbolic form: `2 sinh(σz) sinh(σ(1 - z)) / (σ z (1 - z) sinh σ)` for `σ ≠ 0`.
nodes.title: Hyperbolic form of the sojourn density below the current frequency

nodes.summary: `Ψ₁` through Kimura's fixation probability: `Ψ₁(z) = 2 u(z)(1 - u(z)) / (z (1 - z) u'(z))` on `(0, 1)`.
nodes.title: Sojourn density below the current frequency via fixation probability

nodes.summary: With `N` diploid individuals, selection coefficient `s ≠ 0` and time in generations, the paper prints `Ψ₁(z) = (e^{-γ(1-z)} - 1)(e^{-γz} - 1) / (s z (1 - z)(1 - e^{-γ}))` with `γ = 4Ns`; it equals `2N · maruyamaBelow (2Ns) z`.
nodes.title: Paper units

nodes.summary: For `0 ≤ σ < τ` and `z ∈ (0, 1)`, `Ψ₁` at `τ` is strictly below `Ψ₁` at `σ`.
nodes.title: Stronger selection, smaller `Ψ₁`

nodes.summary: For `σ ≠ 0`, `Ψ₁(z) < 2`, its neutral value, for every `z ∈ (0, 1)`.
nodes.title: Maruyama effect, below the current frequency

nodes.summary: `Ψ₁` is the same for `σ` and `-σ`.
nodes.title: Symmetry

nodes.summary: `Ψ₁` is positive on `(0, 1)`.
nodes.title: Positivity of the sojourn density below the current frequency

nodes.summary: The paper's closed form `Ψ₁(z)` for `0 < z < x` (Kiezun et al. 2013, Methods), in units of `2N` generations with `σ = 2Ns`: `(e^{-2σ(1-z)} - 1)(e^{-2σz} - 1) / (σ z (1 - z) (1 - e^{-2σ}))`, and its continuous extension `2` for `σ = 0`. It does not depend on the current frequency `x`.
nodes.title: Closed-form sojourn density below the current frequency

nodes.summary: Stronger selection, younger alleles, for either sign of selection: if `|σ| < |τ|` then an allele at frequency `x ∈ (0, 1)` under selection `τ` is on average strictly younger than one under selection `σ`.
nodes.title: Stronger selection, younger alleles

nodes.summary: At a fixed frequency `x ∈ (0, 1)`, the mean age is strictly decreasing in `σ ≥ 0`. Kiezun et al. (2013, Figure 1b) show this numerically from the closed forms; here it is proved.
nodes.title: Stronger selection, younger alleles

nodes.summary: For `σ ≠ 0` and `x ∈ (0, 1)`, an allele under selection, advantageous or deleterious, is on average strictly younger than a neutral allele at the same frequency.
nodes.title: The Maruyama effect (Kiezun et al. 2013)

nodes.summary: The mean age is the same for `σ` and `-σ`.
nodes.title: Symmetry

nodes.summary: The mean age of a neutral allele at frequency `x ∈ (0, 1)` is `-2 x log x / (1 - x)` in units of `2N` generations (`-4N x ln x / (1 - x)` generations).
nodes.title: Kimura and Ohta (1973)

nodes.summary: The mean age of an allele at current frequency `x` (the paper's `a(x)`), in units of `2N` generations: `∫₀^x Ψ₁(z) dz + ∫_x^1 Ψ₂(z) dz`.
nodes.title: Mean age of an allele at a given frequency

nodes.summary: For `σ = 0` and `0 < x < 1` the sojourn density is the neutral Green's function.
nodes.title: Neutral case of the sojourn density

nodes.summary: The sojourn density (Green's function) of the Wright–Fisher diffusion with genic selection, time in units of `2N` generations, `σ = 2Ns`. With `u = kimuraFixation σ` and `u'(x) = kimuraSlope σ · e^{-2σx}`,
nodes.title: Sojourn density of the Wright–Fisher diffusion with selection

nodes.summary: Kimura's fixation probability is strictly increasing in the initial frequency.
nodes.title: Kimura's fixation probability is strictly increasing

nodes.summary: Mean age as the limit of conditional sojourn times (Maruyama 1974; Kiezun et al. 2013, Methods): for `x ∈ (0, 1)`, the total conditional sojourn time `∫₀¹ Ψ_z(p, z) dz` of a path from initial frequency `p` to current frequency `x` tends to the mean age `a(x)` as `p → 0⁺` (an allele arises at frequency close to `0`).
nodes.title: Mean age as the limit of conditional sojourn times
